Court No. - 90
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 5712 of 2024
Applicant :- Tar Babu Alias Lallu
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Pankaj Kumar Gupta
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Kuldeep Singh
Hon'ble Vikram D. Chauhan,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Kuldeep Singh, learned counsel for opposite party
no.2 and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the impugned charge sheet
dated 1.7.2017 in Case Crime No.128 of 2017, under Sections 498A, 304-B Ipc and Section 3/4 D.P.
Act, P.S. Phaphund, District Auraiya pending in the court of Additional District Judge-II, Auraiya,
upon which learned court below has taken cognizance of offence against applicant.
3.  Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is father-in-law.
Previously in Application U/S 482 No.1562 of 2018, the order was passed by this Court on 10.8.2018 quashing the criminal case.
He submits that in view of compromise entered into between the parties, which is recorded in the order dated 10.8.2018, the supplementary charge sheet is also required to be quashed.

sentences.text: 1 4. Learned counsel for opposite party no.2 has not disputed the aforesaid fact and has filed counter affidavit.
The same is taken on record.

Learned counsel for opposite party no.2 further submits that he would have no objection in case supplementary charge sheet and the criminal case against applicant are quashed by this Court in view of settlement recorded in Application U/S 482 No.1562 of 2018.
5. Learned AGA does not dispute the fact and he would have no objection in case criminal proceedings are put to an end.
6. The order dated 10.8.2018 passed in Application U/S 482 No.1562 of 2018 is quoted hereinbelow:
"Heard Shri Pankaj Kumar Gupta, learned counsel for the applicant, Shri Sanjay Kumar Singh, learned A.G.A for the State and Shri Ravi Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed to quash the impugned charge sheet dated 7.7.2017 in Case Crime no.0128 of 2017, under Sections 498-A,
304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Phaphund, District Auraiya.
It has been contended by learned counsel for the applicant that the dispute between the parties arises out of matrimonial discord.
This Court vide order dated 29.1.2018 had referred the matter to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court.
A settlement/agreement had been arrived on 27.2.2018 between the parties.
A copy of the same is on record.
Perusal of the settlement/agreement thus reached reveals that the parties have amicably settled their dispute and further agreed to withdraw the cases between them.

Paragraph nos. 6 a) to 6 f) read as under:
"6. The following settlement has been arrived at between the Parties hereto:-
a) That the marriage of Sri Deepak @ Deep Kumar (Applicant no.1 - husband) and Smt. Sonam (O.P No.2, wife) was solemnized on 24.08.2017.
b) That it is relevant to indicate in the Settlement Agreement that the applicant happened to the husband of the real sister of the O.P. No. 2 the marriage which was solemnized on 08.05.2014.

It is further made clear that the 1st wife of Applicant namely Mrs. Sarita Devi met with an unnatural death, the FIR of which was lodged on 31.03.2017 giving rise to case crime No.128/17 u/s 498A, 304 B of IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act P.S. Phaphoond District Auriya in which the O.P. No.2 of instant case Mrs.
Sonam Yadav was the complainant.
the Applicant is employed with Indian Armed Forces and is presently posted at a Highly sensitive place at Indian China Border in Siliguri (W.B.).

c) The applicant and O.P. No.2 have resolve to live together as legally wedded wife along with a female child namely Baby Lalita which was born out of the wed lock Tar Babu Alias Lallu vs State Of U.P. And Another on 12 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16811609/
2 between the applicant and his previous wife (now deceased).
d) Both the parties have further resolved that proceedings in case crime No.128/17 u/s 498A, 304B of IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act P.S. Phaphoond District Auraiya pending before concerned Court will proceed further in accordance with Law.
e) That the husband undertakes to take care of his wife and daughter and provide all essential requirements and amenities in future.
f) That both the parties assure each other that they shall make every possible effort for a happy and congenial relationship and environment."

The application is accordingly allowed."
7.
In view of settlement recorded in Application U/S 482 No.1562 of 2018 by this Court by order dated 10.8.2018, no useful purpose would be served in proceeding with the matter further.

Thus, the proceedings of impugned charge sheet dated 1.7.2017 in Case Crime No.128 of 2017, under Sections 498A, 304-B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Phaphund, District Auraiya is hereby quashed in respect of applicant-Tar Babu Alias Lallu.
8. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is, accordingly, allowed.
